title: $\ M g ^ { 2 + } / \mathsf { A } ^ { | 3 + }$ Co-doped Li-Rich Manganese-Based Oxides for Boosting Rate Performance and Stability of Lithium-Ion Batteries

materials.name: Li1.2Mn0.56Ni0.16Co0.08O2
materials.description: Pristine lithium-rich manganese oxide cathode synthesized by co-precipitation and calcination.

materials.name: Mg-doped Li1.2Mn0.56Ni0.16Co0.08O2
materials.description: LRMO doped with Mg, with Mg occupying Li sites in the Li layer to expand lattice and facilitate Li-ion diffusion.

materials.name: Al-doped Li1.2Mn0.56Ni0.16Co0.08O2
materials.description: LRMO doped with Al, with Al occupying Li sites in the TM slab forming stronger Li–O–Al bonds to stabilize oxygen lattice.

materials.name: Mg/Al co-doped Li1.2Mn0.56Ni0.16Co0.08O2
materials.description: LRMO co-doped with Mg and Al, combining benefits of expanded Li layer and stabilized oxygen framework for enhanced cycling stability and rate performance.
